uncomfortable things to do alone
to become proud of yourself

eat at a nice restaurant alone

no phone. just you
and the food.

join a class where you're
the worst

be a beginner on purpose.

take a day trip alone

pick a town. go.

learn a subject you've
always avoided

history, physics, art.
